name: volume
description: Read or change the loudness (volume level, 0 to 100) of the computer's speakers only, never the microphone and never which device is used: say the current level, set it to a number from 0 to 100, turn it up or down (small, normal or large step), or mute and unmute.

action.description: get reads the level; set needs level; up and down take an optional amount

level.description: only for set: the target volume in percent

amount.description: only for up and down: small = a notch, a bit or a little (5 points), normal (10, the default), large = a lot or much (25)

examples: turn the volume up a bit
not_for: the microphone or any input level
choosing, switching or numbering audio devices (speakers, headphones, microphone)
FRED's own voice volume or mute
choosing the output or input device
